transcript.speaker: Renata Silva
transcript.text: I want to talk through the tension I sensed in the planning session - it felt like you weren't fully on board with deprioritizing the adaptive practice version of the AI tutor.

transcript.speaker: Grace Eze
transcript.text: You read that right. I think the simple version is the right call for this cycle, but I'm worried that if we don't at least prototype adaptive practice soon, a competitor beats us to it and the simple version feels dated by the time we ship it.

transcript.speaker: Renata Silva
transcript.text: That's a fair concern. What would it take to at least de-risk the adaptive version without fully committing engineering time to it this cycle?

transcript.speaker: Grace Eze
transcript.text: I could put together a lightweight research spike - talk to a few teachers about what 'adaptive' would actually need to mean for it to be useful, without writing production code yet. That's maybe a week of my time, not engineering's.

transcript.speaker: Renata Silva
transcript.text: I like that - it keeps engineering focused on the simple version while we learn what we'd need to build next. Can you scope that spike this week?

transcript.speaker: Grace Eze
transcript.text: Yes, I'll talk to three or four teachers from our advisory panel and summarize findings.

transcript.speaker: Renata Silva
transcript.text: Let's plan to review those findings together before we scope next cycle's roadmap, so it actually influences the decision instead of arriving too late.

transcript.speaker: Grace Eze
transcript.text: Agreed, I'll have it ready before the next roadmap planning session.

transcript.speaker: Renata Silva
transcript.text: Separately - how are you feeling about your workload generally? You've got the AI tutor, the course builder feature, and now this spike.

transcript.speaker: Grace Eze
transcript.text: It's a lot, but manageable for now. If the course builder cross-module drag work drags into a second sprint, I might need to hand off some AI tutor coordination to someone else temporarily.

transcript.speaker: Renata Silva
transcript.text: Let's keep an eye on that. Flag it to me directly if it starts to feel unmanageable rather than pushing through quietly.

summary_key_points: Grace raised concern that deprioritizing adaptive AI tutor practice could let a competitor get ahead
A lightweight, non-engineering research spike with teachers will de-risk the adaptive version without committing engineering time this cycle
Findings from the spike will be reviewed before next cycle's roadmap planning
Grace's workload across the AI tutor, course builder, and the new spike will be monitored

decisions: Run a lightweight research spike on adaptive practice instead of committing engineering time this cycle
Review the research spike's findings before scoping next cycle's roadmap
